_comment: Commands are the suite's addressable entry points. This file is the single source of truth: scripts/generate_commands.py renders commands/<name>.md and docs/ENTRY.md from it. Never edit a generated command file by hand; edit this manifest and re-run the generator. A command earns its place by the rule in docs/COMMANDS.md: a verb command (what the user would say, running a flow; flow lists skills only) or a state command (standalone audit or mapping unit). Cap of 12 commands. Skills themselves are not commands — they are already invocable by name.

commands.description: Start here. Say what you want in plain words; the router picks the flow and the first skill.
commands.name: rnov-start
commands.output: The next skill to run, with the classification in three lines.
steps: classify per `using-rnov-skills` and load one skill

commands.name: rnov-new
commands.output: The new-product flow running, starting at setup and brief.
steps: setup (if absent) → brief → research (if facts are missing) → grill → define-product → design → model → spec → tickets → implement → review → verify → ship → retro.

commands.name: rnov-improve
commands.output: The improvement flow running, starting at brief (short).
steps: brief (short) → grill (only the new decisions) → define-product (delta stories) → design/model deltas → spec → tickets → implement → review → verify → ship.

commands.description: Improve a UI surface, audit first.
commands.name: rnov-improve-ui
commands.output: Audit findings in REVIEW.md under an Audit heading, then the improvement flow.
steps: audit (`design`, Audit an existing UI) → design deltas → keyframe gate → implement → review → verify

commands.name: rnov-fix
commands.output: The fix as one ticket, reviewed and verified.
steps: debug (red feedback loop first) → implement the fix as one ticket → review → verify.

commands.description: Goldfish this spec: five fresh-context stages that test whether a stranger could understand and re-implement it.
commands.name: rnov-goldfish
commands.output: Consolidated findings in REVIEW.md with suite severities; per-stage reports in the run folder.
steps: Follow the `review` skill, Goldfish protocol section: semantic split first (Detailed Implementation header).
Stage 1 initial zoom-out, then stage 2 comprehension, stage 3 critic (lenses in parallel, synthesised), stage 4 intermediate zoom-out with the stage 1 report, stage 5 implementation readiness.
Each stage is a fresh reviewer; at most one re-audit per stage.
Consolidate into REVIEW.md with a traceability line per finding; per-stage reports live in the run folder.

commands.description: Document an undocumented codebase bottom-up into per-directory README contracts, leaf first.
commands.name: rnov-bootstrap
commands.output: Per-directory README contracts with sentinel markers; placeholders logged as documentation owed, not as completed contracts.
commands.section: ## Bootstrap mode (own codebase, no design docs)
steps: Follow the `recon` skill, Bootstrap mode section. Discover breadth-first and prune test-only and empty directories; above fifteen directories, pause for human approval before any swarm is spawned.
Scout each directory read-only with bounded reads; write leaf Component Package contracts first, then parent Blueprints post-order.
Preserve human notes inside the sentinel markers; never overwrite an existing README wholesale.
Final pass: every section present and populated, every relative link resolves, verification targets match the test configuration.

commands.description: Check whether the code has drifted: sweep a tree's SPEC.md, DESIGN.md, and README contracts against the current code and report only the divergences.
commands.name: rnov-drift
commands.output: Differences-only report at docs/drift/<YYYY-MM-DD>-DRIFT_REPORT.md with coverage stated.
steps: Follow the `verify` skill, Drift sweep section. For each document, read it, locate the source it names, and compare against the current code.
Check the ADRs before flagging: intentional divergence is recorded with its ADR cited, not flagged as drift.
Every item carries its evidence (doc section and code location) and a severity from the suite's scale; triage findings like review findings (CONTEST with evidence, or PROPOSE FIX).
State the coverage plainly: the sweep is a read-and-judge comparison, bounded by what was actually read.
